bio: Roy Asberry Cooper III (born June 13, 1957) is an American politician and lawyer who is the United States senator-elect from North Carolina. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served as the 75th governor of North Carolina (2017–2025), as the 50th attorney general of North Carolina (2001–2017), and in the North Carolina General Assembly (1987–2001).
offices: Member of the North Carolina Senate (1991–2001)
Member of the North Carolina House of Representatives (1987–1991)
